name: 日付と時刻の個別指定欄
prompt:
Refine candidate 1 so the two date/time fields fill the source crop more closely. The assigned source crop is 641×133 pixels (aspect 4.82:1), equivalent to a compact 212×44 field-pair. Keep two adjoining rounded light-gray fields only, with about 3–4px top/bottom whitespace and a 4–5px center gap.

Exact values: left 「2026年6月4日」 in dark near-black; right 「12:00」 in blue (#3478F2). The date remains dark, and only the time value is blue. Both fields have uniform neutral gray fills from the source, not mint and not gradient. Make each field about 36px high; left width about110px, right width96px. Keep corners about10px.

Candidate 1 has excessive blank vertical canvas around short fields. Remove those margins; do not place the controls in the middle of a tall page. Use no label because 「解除する日時」 is outside the crop. No icons, chrome, footer, title, wheel, or shadows. Static image only.
reviewNotes: Candidate 2 keeps 12:00 blue and the date dark, but the 3:1-ish generated canvas adds substantial top whitespace and vertically displaces both fields relative to the assigned crop. Two attempts used; retain needs-correction.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
